sum: Token Cat Limited, through its subsidiaries, operates as an omni-channel automotive marketplace in the People's Republic of China. It also offers electronic equipment trading and technical support, and consulting services; subscription and support services; The company was formerly known as TuanChe Limited and changed its name to Token Cat Limited in February 2025. Token Cat Limited was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
ceo: Mr. Zhanli  Wang (CEO, CFO & Chairman of the Board)
